title: Electrical Apprentice
eligibility_raw: Class 10 and recognised ITI Electrician. Freshers accepted. Age 18–25.

title: Junior Electrical Technician
eligibility_raw: Recognised ITI Electrician and 12 months documented maintenance experience required.

title: Maintenance Trainee
eligibility_raw: ITI or Diploma in a relevant engineering trade. Fresh candidates may apply.

title: Office Assistant Trainee
eligibility_raw: Higher Secondary pass. Working knowledge of documents and spreadsheets. Freshers may apply.

title: Data Entry Operator
eligibility_raw: 12th pass and basic computer certificate. Accurate data entry required; Hindi Unicode typing desirable.

title: Customer Support Associate
eligibility_raw: Minimum 12th pass. Clear spoken Hindi and customer handling ability required.

title: Fitter Apprentice
eligibility_raw: Class 10 and recognised ITI Fitter certificate. No prior employment required.

title: Assembly Line Trainee
eligibility_raw: 10th pass with technical trade exposure. ITI Fitter preferred. Freshers accepted after assessment.

title: Retail Operations Apprentice
eligibility_raw: 12th pass. Hindi communication and willingness to work rotational shifts required.

title: Warehouse Inventory Assistant
eligibility_raw: 12th pass and six months inventory or store experience. Basic spreadsheet use required.

title: Graduate Operations Apprentice
eligibility_raw: Graduate in any stream. Basic computer and Hindi communication skills required.

title: Solar Installation Apprentice
eligibility_raw: ITI Electrician. Field travel and safe work-at-height training required.
